entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: The Bab Gedid Mosque, also known as the Eski Mosque was an Ottoman-period mosque on the Aegean island of Kos, in southeastern Greece, before it was badly damaged in an earthquake in 1933 and finally demolished a few years later in 1935. Today its octagonal stone minaret is all that survives from the original structure.
